The obtained TiAl-based composite with 0.10 at.% LaB6 addition exhibits significant improvements in microstructural stability and mechanical properties.

In this study, nano-LaB6 particles were mixed with the pre-alloyed Ti-45Al-8Nb (at.%) powders as a precursor for in-situ synthesis of TiAl-based composites via DED. The obtained TiAl-based composite with 0.10 at.% LaB6 addition exhibits significant improvements in microstructural stability and mechanical properties.

The pre-alloyed powders and nano-LaB6 particles were mixed for 12 h using low-speed ball milling with ZrO2 grinding balls at a rotation speed of 150 r/min and a ball-to-powder weight ratio of 3: 1.
Finally, the mixed TiAl/LaB6 powders were vacuum-dried in an oven at 120 ◦C for 24 h.
